inventory_findings.caveat: Page advertises motorized bearings/spin drives; no such implementation identified in this release. Absence of names alone is not proof about other versions.

integration_findings: Sable getEntityOrientation CAMERA return hook filters the actual ridden sublevel pose. Fourth Dimension keeps this single physical transform owner.
CameraFilter freshOrientation normally depends on smoothing cache; a client-only exact-version adapter supplies the authoritative registered carrier render pose even with head inertia disabled.
Camera master did not guard cameraProcessingActive; the adapter bypasses orientation filtering for local 4D riders when camera.enabled is false.
Transient bank, G response, head inertia, body travel, launch and motion history reset on local 4D seat/carrier/rider/world transitions and camera master toggles.
The runtime item registry contains the seat aligner. No CoasterDrive/motorized-bearing or spin-drive implementation was found in this artifact; page descriptions do not establish this release API.
